why: A carriage return that is not followed by a line feed sends the terminal back to column 0, and what follows overwrites what came before: the reviewer reads the second half of the line, the model reads both. The class the plan started from allowed CR outright, which is exactly this hole (evasao-adversarial measured it). The fail side is README.md with one bare CR in the middle of a line. The pass side is the same README with CRLF endings: a CR that ends a line is not a control trick, and failing it would fail every file saved on Windows.
